meta.node_id_convention_summary: farm_manager is the legacy module: service/repository nodes are class-level PascalCase (farm_manager.service.<ClassName>) with layer=service|repository|infrastructure and node_type=class, matching the 31 pre-existing farm service nodes. Function-only service modules (no class to name) use the dotted file subpath under services/ (farm_manager.service.<subpkg>.<module>) with node_type=function — documented divergence, see task report. Collections are collection_<snake> db_model nodes with layer=model. Repository->collection edges use the FULL node_id on the source side (farm_manager.service.HarvestRepository), NOT the bare class name used by ~20 pre-existing edges, because map_generator.get_edges_for_node matches node_id exactly and the bare-name edges never resolve.

nodes.name: HarvestService
nodes.description: Block harvest business logic. Plant Library harvest routing (Stage 3): submit_harvest_batch() validates a multi-line submission against the block's productMotherId -> plant_mothers.products[] (unknown/inactive product = 400; qualityGrade required for sellable/process and REJECTED on waste), validates ALL lines before writing anything, then routes each line by ProductCategory under one server-generated harvestBatchId: SELLABLE -> _route_sellable_line -> block_harvests + inventory_harvest FIFO batch; PROCESS -> _route_process_line -> processing_inventory; WASTE -> _route_waste_line -> inventory_waste directly (sourceType=HARVEST, originalGrade null). get_batch_lookup(block, date) fans out across all three destinations and groups by harvestBatchId (ungrouped legacy rows become singleton groups); the plain harvest list stays block_harvests-only.

nodes.name: HarvestRepository
nodes.description: Data access for block_harvests. create() now takes keyword-only product_id / product_name / harvest_batch_id (all Optional, None for every legacy caller): product_name is a FROZEN snapshot never re-derived, harvest_batch_id groups the row with its sibling process/waste lines. Also stamps farmingYear from system_config and recomputes block KPI rollups.

nodes.name: ArchiveRepository
nodes.description: Data access for block_archives plus cycle archiving and performance aggregations. archive_block_cycle() now copies productMotherId/productName off the block into the archive - BlockArchive has carried those fields since Plant Library Phase 1 but the constructor never populated them, so every archive written since then got nulls.

nodes.name: PlantDataEnhancedService
nodes.description: Variety-level plant library CRUD (growth cycles, fertigation, spacing, search, clone, CSV import/export). Mother/variety-aware: CSV import resolves or creates the PlantMother row and stamps motherPlantId/varietyName on each variety; variety-create under an existing mother is delegated in from PlantMotherService.

nodes.name: PlantDataEnhancedRepository
nodes.description: Data access for plant_data_enhanced (COLLECTION constant, also read by PlantMotherRepository). Mother-aware lookups get_by_mother() and get_by_mother_and_variety_name() back the variety-under-mother uniqueness rule; soft_delete via deletedAt.

nodes.name: PlantMotherService
nodes.description: Plant Library mother (product/folder) orchestration. Beyond mother/variety CRUD it now owns the embedded products[] catalog that harvest routing depends on: add_product / list_products / update_product / deactivate_product, name-uniqueness checks, _ensure_active_sellable_default (a mother always keeps one active SELLABLE product) and _assert_keeps_active_sellable_product guarding update/deactivate. Variety creation is delegated to PlantDataEnhancedService.

nodes.name: PlantMotherRepository
nodes.description: Data access for plant_mothers. set_products() persists the embedded products[] array (indexed on products.productId) that HarvestService reads to resolve a harvest line's category; cascade_rename() propagates a mother rename into plant_data_enhanced via the motherPlantId index; list_mothers() joins variety counts from PlantDataEnhancedRepository.COLLECTION.

nodes.name: FarmDatabaseManager
nodes.description: Farm module MongoDB facade (delegates the connection to core src.services.database) and the single owner of _create_indexes() for every farm collection. Plant Library harvest routing added indexes for two NEW collections - processing_inventory (inventoryId unique, organizationId/farmId/blockId/productId/harvestBatchId/harvestDate) and inventory_waste (harvestBatchId, sourceBlockId) - plus block_harvests.productId and block_harvests.harvestBatchId. Exposes the module-level `farm_db` singleton every repository imports.

nodes.name: AIDashboardService
nodes.description: Orchestrates AI Dashboard inspections (DataCollector -> ReportGenerator) and persists reports to the ai_dashboard_reports collection.

nodes.name: DataCollector
nodes.description: Runs 9 AI Dashboard inspection tasks in parallel via asyncio.gather across farm/block/harvest/alert repositories and SenseHub cache; each task is isolated so one failure sets its raw-data field to None instead of aborting the inspection.

nodes.name: ReportGenerator
nodes.description: Passes raw AI Dashboard inspection data to Vertex AI Gemini and parses the structured JSON response into an AISummary.

nodes.name: AIDashboardScheduler
nodes.description: Singleton asyncio background scheduler: waits 60s after startup, runs an initial AI Dashboard inspection, then repeats every 4 hours.

nodes.name: AIHubService
nodes.description: Platform-wide (no farm scoping) Vertex AI Gemini orchestration for the unified AI Hub. Four sections - Control (read+write), Monitor, Report, Advise - share one Gemini pipeline but get different system prompts and tool sets; write tools route through the same Redis pending-action confirmation flow as the farm-level AI services.

nodes.name: ReportExporter
nodes.description: Pure synchronous converter from AI-generated markdown report text to PDF (reportlab) or Excel (openpyxl) bytes; touches no DB or external service.

nodes.name: FarmLevelAIChatService
nodes.description: Farm-scoped Vertex AI Gemini chat: builds context over ALL blocks on a farm, resolves block_code -> SenseHub client per tool call, and gates write actions behind the pending-action confirmation flow.

nodes.name: GlobalAIChatService
nodes.description: Strictly read-only cross-farm Vertex AI Gemini monitoring assistant. Stateless static methods; no write tools and no pending-action flow. Farms/blocks are resolved by name, not UUID.

nodes.name: SenseHubCacheQueryService
nodes.description: Stateless read layer over the sensehub_*_cache collections (equipment, alerts, lab, snapshots, sync log). Used by API endpoints and as the AI tool fallback when live SenseHub is unreachable.

nodes.name: SenseHubCropSync
nodes.description: Crop-specific MCP layer wrapping SenseHubMCPClient, one instance per block MCP session (from_block). Builds the set_crop_data payload from PlantDataEnhanced optimal ranges and stage durations. Fire-and-log: never raises, returns None on failure.

nodes.name: SenseHubSyncService
nodes.description: Singleton once-per-day background sync pulling equipment, alerts, lab data and snapshots from every IoT-connected SenseHub instance into MongoDB so dashboards and AI tools can fall back to cache when SenseHub is offline. Also re-pushes crop data via SenseHubCropSync.

nodes.name: BlockHistoryRepository
nodes.description: Data access for the block_history archive collection, including per-crop performance statistics aggregations.

nodes.name: ReturnedInventoryRepository
nodes.description: Data access for inventory_returned. Takes an injected Motor db (FastAPI dependency) rather than the farm_db singleton, matching the inventory API. mark_as_waste() moves a returned row into inventory_waste.

nodes.name: CalculationListsRepository
nodes.description: CRUD for fertilizer_calculation_lists (saved fertilizer-cost calculations), scoped by organizationId.

nodes.name: ChemicalsRepository
nodes.description: CRUD for fertilizer_chemicals, org-scoped and archived-excluded by default. Soft-delete via archivedAt with check_dependents() validating against plant_data_enhanced fertigation schedules; name matching is case-insensitive (en/strength 2 collation).

nodes.name: ChemicalsService
nodes.description: Chemical catalog business logic. discover_from_plant_library() walks every plant_data_enhanced fertigation schedule and auto-creates FertilizerChemical rows for unknown ingredient names; archive-aware - a name matching an archived chemical returns the ArchivedChemicalMatch sentinel instead of resurrecting the record.

nodes.name: PriceBook
nodes.description: Resolves a per-org price per chemical in order: fertilizer_price_overrides (manual AED override) -> inventory_input where category='fertilizer' matched on chemical name or alias -> source='none' (unknown).

nodes.name: WatchdogService
nodes.description: Watchdog orchestrator: runs the five checkers, filters issues through a per-issue cooldown, sends Telegram notifications and records them in watchdog_notifications.

nodes.name: WatchdogConfigService
nodes.description: CRUD for watchdog configuration stored in the system_config collection, including encrypted Telegram bot-token storage and masking.

nodes.name: WatchdogScheduler
nodes.description: Singleton asyncio background loop that re-reads checkIntervalMinutes from DB each cycle (admin changes apply without restart) and takes a Redis distributed lock so only ONE Uvicorn worker runs the check per cycle.

nodes.name: TelegramService
nodes.description: httpx-based Telegram Bot API client using only sendMessage and getMe; no external Telegram library.

nodes.name: AlertChecker
nodes.description: Watchdog checker: finds active alerts at or above the configured HIGH/CRITICAL severity threshold.

nodes.name: BlockHealthChecker
nodes.description: Watchdog checker: blocks sitting in ALERT status or with a stale IoT sync timestamp.

nodes.name: LateItemsChecker
nodes.description: Watchdog checker: block_cycles past their estimated harvest date with no actual harvest recorded.

nodes.name: MCPChecker
nodes.description: Watchdog checker: probes MCP endpoint reachability for every IoT-connected block.

nodes.name: SystemHealthChecker
nodes.description: Watchdog checker: internal health probe of API, MongoDB and Redis.

nodes.name: process_expired_harvest_inventory
nodes.description: Daily job scanning inventory_harvest for rows past expiryDate with availableQuantity > 0: writes an inventory_waste record (sourceType=EXPIRED), zeroes availableQuantity and appends an inventory_movements entry.

nodes.name: sensehub_block_service_triggers
nodes.description: Fire-and-forget SenseHub triggers for BlockService.change_status, extracted to keep block_service_new.py readable. Called via asyncio.create_task and must never raise - all exceptions are caught and logged at ERROR.

nodes.name: build_system_prompt
nodes.description: Builds the block-scoped Farm AI system prompt from MongoDB block, crop and growth-stage data, including a formatted fertigation context.

nodes.name: farm_ai tool_executor
nodes.description: Maps Gemini tool_use calls to SenseHubClient methods and web search for the block-level Farm AI. Read tools execute immediately (falling back to SenseHubCacheQueryService when SenseHub is unreachable); write tools return a description for the pending-action confirmation flow.

nodes.name: farm_ai pending_actions
nodes.description: Redis-backed store for AI write actions awaiting user confirmation (300s TTL). Shared by the farm-level, farm-scoped and AI Hub chat services.

nodes.name: build_farm_system_prompt
nodes.description: Builds the farm-level AI system prompt by loading the farm and ALL of its active blocks, so the assistant can coordinate multi-block operations.

nodes.name: farm_level_ai tool_executor
nodes.description: Farm-scoped Gemini tool executor: resolves each tool call's block_code to a block document and its SenseHub connection before delegating to SenseHubClient. Also reused by AIHubService for the Hub's block-level tools.

nodes.name: build_global_system_prompt
nodes.description: Builds the cross-farm monitoring system prompt from a summary of all farms and their connected block counts.

nodes.name: global_ai tool_executor
nodes.description: Read-only cross-farm Gemini tool executor over MongoDB and SenseHub HTTP clients. Farms and blocks are resolved by case-insensitive name because that is how users refer to them. Also reused by AIHubService for the Hub's global tools.

nodes.name: build_hub_system_prompt
nodes.description: Builds the section-specific AI Hub system prompt (Control / Monitor / Report / Advise) over a platform-wide farm summary.

nodes.name: compute_stage
nodes.description: Pure deterministic mapper from A64 block state + days-since-planting to SenseHub's stage enum, using the variety's GrowthCycleDuration (germination -> vegetative -> flowering -> fruiting). No IO.

nodes.name: calculate_for_crops
nodes.description: Pure calculation engine for the Fertilizer Cost Calculator: loads plant_data_enhanced documents, walks each fertigation schedule (interval and custom rules) to sum per-point ingredient quantities, normalises units, then prices them through PriceBook.

nodes.name: excel_handler
nodes.description: openpyxl export/import for the Fertilizer Cost Calculator: .xlsx export with per-crop Calculation and Warnings sheets, plus a template builder and crop-list importer.

nodes.name: processing_inventory
nodes.description: MongoDB collection: processing_inventory - NEW destination for `process`-category harvest lines, deliberately separate from inventory_harvest (which holds sellable stock only). Written by HarvestService._route_process_line; carries organizationId, farmId, blockId, productId, productName, quantity/unit, qualityGrade, harvestDate and harvestBatchId. Indexed on inventoryId (unique), organizationId, farmId, blockId, productId, harvestBatchId, harvestDate, createdAt.

nodes.name: inventory_waste
nodes.description: MongoDB collection: inventory_waste - waste stock. Now also the DIRECT destination for `waste`-category harvest lines (HarvestService._route_waste_line writes sourceType=HARVEST, sourceBlockId, productId, plantName from the product name, originalGrade null - harvest waste is never graded), alongside expiry (expiry_cron, sourceType=EXPIRED) and returned-stock write-offs. New indexes on harvestBatchId and sourceBlockId back the batch-lookup endpoint.

nodes.name: inventory_returned
nodes.description: MongoDB collection: inventory_returned - returned harvest stock awaiting disposition; rows can be written off into inventory_waste via ReturnedInventoryRepository.mark_as_waste().

nodes.name: block_history
nodes.description: MongoDB collection: block_history - archived block history records with per-crop performance statistics.

nodes.name: ai_dashboard_reports
nodes.description: MongoDB collection: ai_dashboard_reports - persisted AI Dashboard inspection reports (raw inspection data + Gemini-generated AISummary), written every 4 hours by AIDashboardScheduler.

nodes.name: watchdog_notifications
nodes.description: MongoDB collection: watchdog_notifications - history of watchdog issues that passed the cooldown filter and were sent to Telegram; also backs the per-issue cooldown check.

nodes.name: fertilizer_chemicals
nodes.description: MongoDB collection: fertilizer_chemicals - per-org master chemical catalog for the Fertilizer Cost Calculator. Soft-deleted via archivedAt; unique-ish name index uses a case-insensitive collation (en, strength 2).

nodes.name: fertilizer_price_overrides
nodes.description: MongoDB collection: fertilizer_price_overrides - manual per-org AED price per chemical; first lookup step in PriceBook before falling back to inventory_input.

nodes.name: fertilizer_calculation_lists
nodes.description: MongoDB collection: fertilizer_calculation_lists - saved fertilizer-cost calculation lists, scoped by organizationId and creator.

nodes.name: sensehub_equipment_cache
nodes.description: MongoDB collection: sensehub_equipment_cache - daily snapshot of SenseHub equipment per block, read by SenseHubCacheQueryService when live SenseHub is unreachable.

nodes.name: sensehub_alerts_cache
nodes.description: MongoDB collection: sensehub_alerts_cache - cached SenseHub alerts per block for offline fallback.

nodes.name: sensehub_lab_cache
nodes.description: MongoDB collection: sensehub_lab_cache - cached SenseHub lab readings; queried latest-per-metric and paginated by SenseHubCacheQueryService.

nodes.name: sensehub_snapshots_cache
nodes.description: MongoDB collection: sensehub_snapshots_cache - cached SenseHub camera snapshot metadata per block.

nodes.name: sensehub_sync_log
nodes.description: MongoDB collection: sensehub_sync_log - per-run SenseHub sync history (counts, errors, duration) surfaced by get_sync_history/get_status.
